content.short: Community that supports and amplifies projects that are impacting climate change and sustainability.
content.description: Cardano 4 Climate is a community initiative that supports climate action and sustainability projects connected to the Cardano ecosystem. The group highlights the opportunity to combine blockchain coordination with new models for regeneration, environmental impact, and long-term climate solutions. By amplifying projects, sharing knowledge, and encouraging collaboration, Cardano 4 Climate aims to help builders use Cardano technology for social, ecological, and economic resilience across real communities.
